accepted_mutants.gold_sql: SELECT email FROM users WHERE role = 'member' AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'high' GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3)
accepted_mutants.mutant_sql:
WITH high_ticket_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM support_tickets
    WHERE priority = 'high'
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT u.email
FROM users u
JOIN high_ticket_accounts hta ON u.account_id = hta.account_id
WHERE u.role = 'member'

P2.2_null_handling_lost_rows.question: Per ticket category among normal tickets opened 2023-07-16 to 2024-04-13, give the number with no user_id next to the total number of tickets.
P2.2_null_handling_lost_rows.gold_sql: SELECT category, SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'normal' AND opened_at >= '2023-07-16' AND opened_at < '2024-04-13' GROUP BY category
P2.2_null_handling_lost_rows.teacher_sql:
SELECT
    category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_user_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM support_tickets
WHERE priority = 'normal'
  AND date(opened_at) BETWEEN '2023-07-16' AND '2024-04-13'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

P2.2_null_handling_lost_rows.question: How many churned accounts have no sales rep assigned, per country?
P2.2_null_handling_lost_rows.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE sales_rep IS NULL AND status = 'churned' GROUP BY country
P2.2_null_handling_lost_rows.teacher_sql:
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS churned_no_sales_rep
FROM accounts
WHERE status = 'churned'
  AND sales_rep IS NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY country
